role: CMS page metadata flags, scalar revisions and collection records
known_patches: Integer source identity argument schemas including shorthand forms
Actual page/collection substring and revision-page exact filters; no write/guard changes
limitations: All 96 source tools remain; only nine listed scalar write tools are certified.

page_edit_save_draft creates Revision content but does not update Page title/latest-revision pointers or full draft content. page_edit_publish also only inserts Revision; full publishing is not claimed.
page_bulk_publish is verified for a scalar id and live=true only, not list/all/descendant batching. Lock/unlock are flags and do not fully prevent later edits or clear lock metadata.

page_create incorrectly uses parent_page_id for path/depth/url/locale; page_move/tree descendants and collection parent/path handling are incomplete. Collection writes certify scalar name records only.

Original page ACLs are largely authentication-only; locks do not prevent source draft insertion. page_delete protects depth1 but does not establish path-based descendant cascades or complete deletion logs.

Revision.object_id has a text schema but source draft insert writes numeric page_id; helpers/filtered revision reads use the producer numeric representation. Raw string-id legacy revisions require matching normalization upstream.
Media tools contain metadata/size placeholders and do not transfer binary data. No complete CMS publication, moderation, search ranking or security workflow is certified.
